name: Gain Medya A.Ş.
note: Media company behind the Gain digital platform, the name and chest sponsor of Beşiktaş's men's basketball team. Anahat Medya A.Ş., founded by Selahattin Aydın, bought GAİN Medya A.Ş. on 22 January 2025 for 450 million TL (gain-anahat-ownership). On 16 December 2025 an Istanbul duty criminal court of peace appointed TMSF as trustee over GAİN Medya and six affiliated companies, including Anahat Holding, during a betting and money-laundering investigation (gain-tmsf-trusteeship); the trusteeship is temporary and the investigation was still under way in 2026.
